messages:
maria: Hey devs — sampleapp's rerank flow started failing in staging after we switched to the Node batching helper. Getting `400 Bad Request` and the body shows `vector length mismatch: expected 768 got 512`.

maria: Repro snippet:
```js
const docs = [...]; // 12 docs
const res = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'rwd/text-embed-v1', input: docs})
// res.data[0].embedding -> length 512
await client.rerank.create({model: 'rwd/rerank-v1', query, candidates: res.data.map(d=>d.embedding)})
```

josh: ugh. can you paste the exact request payload that hit the rerank endpoint? is the batching helper doing any reshape?

maria: pasted the body (trimmed):
```
{"query":"...","candidates":[[0.123,...(512 floats)...],[...]]}
``` 
Python sampleapp using the python sdk produces 768-length vectors for the same model id.

taylor: weird. two hypotheses: 1) node sdk is accidentally using a legacy/quantized endpoint alias that returns 512, 2) batching helper is collapsing dtype or returning float16 and server validates shape differently. Can you `console.log(res.data[0].embedding.length)` from Node? also which SDK version?

maria: confirmed: Node v2.3.1 -> length 512. Python v1.8.0 -> length 768.

ryan: Looks like a mapping/regression. The model id `rwd/text-embed-v1` should be 768. @taylor can we check the Node SDK model-alias table? maybe a default alias was swapped during rollout.

taylor: checking... quick grep shows `text-embed` alias points to `rwd/text-embed-512` in the Node map for v2.3.0+. probable cause: recent alias update only patched the Python mapping.

maria: argh. OK temporary workaround for staging: padding to 768 on the client side so rerank accepts it. snippet:
```js
function padTo768(vec){
  if(vec.length>=768) return vec.slice(0,768);
  return [...vec, ...new Array(768-vec.length).fill(0)];
}
const padded = res.data.map(d=>padTo768(d.embedding));
await client.rerank.create({model:'rwd/rerank-v1', query, candidates: padded})
```

josh: :facepalm: good emergency hotfix. we should also make the server return a clearer error (e.g., `expected dims 768, got 512, check model alias`) and docs should call out model dim per alias.

taylor: will open a patch: 1) update Node alias table to point to 768 model, 2) add unit test comparing SDK mappings across languages, 3) improve error message from rerank service. tagging eng-devex and eng-runtime.

ci-bot: created issue RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1423 (node alias mismatch) :rocket:

maria: I'll add a minimal repro repo and paste logs + exact payloads into the issue. also adding note about retry behavior — currently the client retries on 500s but not 400s; if we return clearer 4xx then it helps DX.

ryan: solid. follow-up: add a small e2e in sampleapp to assert embedding length == rerank.expected_dim at startup, fail-fast so onboarding doesn't hit this.

maria: perfect. thanks all. deploying the pad workaround to staging now. :thumbsup:
